annotations.title: Check a Chinese supplier: USCC, sanctions, Entity List, UFLPA (paid)

description: Use before paying or importing from a Chinese supplier: checks the 18-character Unified Social Credit Code (checksum, registration authority, entity type, province; Xinjiang is flagged), and screens the company against EU, UN, UK and US OFAC sanctions, the BIS Entity List, Military End User list and the DHS UFLPA Entity List. Verdict pass, review or block_review with reasons. Does not query the Chinese register (GSXT). Input: name, uscc. Costs 0.03 USDC via x402, or 15 credits of a Factline API key.

name.description: Supplier name in Latin letters, as on the invoice

uscc.description: 18-character Unified Social Credit Code from the business licence
